title: Goldbach's Conjecture
subtitle: Unsolved problem
summary: Every even integer greater than 2 is the sum of two primes.
detail:
Proposed in 1742. Verified computationally up to 4×10¹⁸. Chen (1966) proved every sufficiently large even integer is the sum of a prime and a product of at most two primes.

\[\forall n\ge 2,\;2n=p+q\text{ for primes }p,q\]
